note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a CIV 24-33, 39-41; A06b CIV 24-33, 39-41; L05 CIV 48): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Cote dIvoire, 2024
sources.said: Person has been habitually and legally resident in Cote d'Ivoire for 5 years. ... n.a. ... Person acquires citizenship of another country.  Loss is subordinated to authorisation of government during 15 period following inscription on lists for military service (these lists were never established).
